Here are concise assertions for `humaneval_parse_music.solve`, categorized for clarity:

**Core Functionality & Input Handling:**

*   `assert solve("C4") == "C4"`  (Basic note parsing)
*   `assert solve("C#4") == "C#4"` (Sharp note)
*   `assert solve("Db4") == "Db4"` (Flat note)
*   `assert solve("C4#") == "C4#"` (Alternative sharp notation)
*   `assert solve("C4b") == "C4b"` (Alternative flat notation)
*   `assert solve("C") == "C"` (Note without octave)
*   `assert solve("C#") == "C#"` (Sharp without octave)
*   `assert solve("Db") == "Db"` (Flat without octave)
*   `assert solve("C0") == "C0"` (Lowest octave)
*   `assert solve("C9") == "C9"` (Highest octave - assuming 9 is valid)
*   `assert solve("A4") == "A4"` (Another note)
*
